mix_policy.cue_density_target_per_minute: 10–20; Wave03 planned 47 object-specific arrivals over 269.8s (10.45/min estimated)
mix_policy.panning: Each cue is noncentral and follows the visible object's landing x-position; pan is baked on GitHub-hosted Ubuntu with FFmpeg stereotools balance_out in [-0.78,+0.78].
mix_policy.ducking: none; no music bed is selected. Effects stay at catalog gains and actual narration masking requires root review after hosted voice exists.
mix_policy.music_policy: none; preserve clean narration and source-led visual rhythm

licence_evidence.catalog_output_format: 48 kHz stereo PCM24, onset-trimmed, 3 ms fade-in, -1 dBTP
licence_evidence.hosted_materialisation: Root-reviewed workflow step must materialise exact catalog outputs, verify each source SHA-256, produce cue-specific panned PCM outputs on the pinned Ubuntu runner, and record each derivative SHA-256 before production build.
